title: 낯선 골목
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a repetitive four-bar arpeggiated pattern with light chorus and delay. A soft, rounded synth bass enters on the downbeat of the first verse. Percussion consists of a dry, mid-range kick drum on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp rimshot on beats 2 and 4. Soft shakers provide sixteenth-note subdivision. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate tenor range with subtle double-tracking on key phrases. The arrangement is sparse and minimalist. Tempo is 82 BPM in 4/4 time. Key is G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar with chorus]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
[soft synth bass enters]
붓을 씻었어
그림 시작 전 [dry kick drum and rimshot enter]

물에 담갔다 빼서
털이 정돈됐어
기분이 좋아졌어
이게 시작이야
[Chorus]
팔레트 물도 바꿨어
종이도 골랐어
어떤 걸 그릴지는
